items.title: Remove or collapse the in-bout stance/technique cheat sheet card
items.what: In gameplay screens (Screenshots 3, 4, 5, 9, 11, 14, 15), a rounded card containing 6 lines of control instructions ('STANCE ◄ step ▲ jump... TECHNIQUE ◄ back ► forward...') is permanently anchored in the lower midground between the tatami mat and the virtual sticks.
items.why: It eats ~100px of vertical space in a portrait layout, forces the fighters to appear smaller, and clutters the combat zone during live play even though a dedicated 'MOVES' modal button already exists in the top right.
items.how: Hide this card during active combat after the first tutorial round, or collapse it into a subtle toggle tab, allowing the camera to frame down closer to the fighters for better action readability.

items.title: Add contact occlusion shadows beneath fighter feet
items.what: Across all fighting frames (e.g., Screenshots 3, 5, 9, 11, 14), the fighters' feet touch the tatami texture with only a diffuse, soft spotlight blob centered beneath their pelvis, leaving the bare feet without local ground shadows.
items.why: The crisp cutout contours of the feet lack depth anchoring, making the photoreal sprites look like flat stickers floating across the 3D mat.
items.how: Project tight, high-opacity contact ambient-occlusion shadows directly under each foot mesh/sprite bone that scale with vertical movement, anchoring them firmly to the mat surface.

items.title: Increase contrast and luminance for Player 2 name in the top HUD
items.what: On the top scoreboard bar across fight screens (Screenshots 2, 3, 5, 6, 8, 10, 13, 14), 'HASANABI' is rendered in a deep muted burgundy-red on a near-black header bar.
items.why: The contrast ratio against the dark background fails legibility on mobile screens under normal ambient lighting, appearing almost unreadable compared to Asmongold's crisp white text.
items.how: Shift P2's font color from deep maroon to a high-luminance vermilion/coral (e.g., #FF6358) with a soft dark text drop-shadow to maintain team identity while guaranteeing WCAG AA contrast.

items.title: Properly format half-point score fraction alignment
items.what: In Screenshots 6 and 13 ('HASANABI WINS 0 - 2 1/2') and the top HUD in Screenshots 13 and 14 ('1/2'), half-points are rendered as unaligned stacked fractions where the denominator drops below the font baseline and collides with spacing margins.
items.why: The misaligned fraction numbers look like an unformatted layout glitch rather than an intentional martial arts tournament score.
items.how: Replace ad-hoc stacked numbers with a dedicated typographic Unicode fraction glyph ('½') aligned to the uppercase font cap-height, or represent half-points as round pip indicators (e.g., Waza-ari dots) beside the main numeral.

items.title: Add cardinal gate detents to the virtual thumbsticks
items.what: In Screenshots 3, 4, and 9, the virtual thumbsticks are rendered as continuous 360-degree smooth spherical dials (deflecting freely diagonally as in Screenshot 4), while the game's mechanics rely purely on 4 discrete cardinal inputs.
items.why: On a touch glass surface with no physical feedback, free-floating analog travel leads to frequent dropped inputs and diagonal ambiguity during fast combat execution.
items.how: Overlay subtle 4-way crosshair detent grooves or illuminate the cardinal arrow chevrons when the stick enters their respective directional actuation cones.
